# solidtype

> Solid, typed, for OCaml front ends on SolidJS and Kobalte, compiled by Melange. A component is written in OCaml's JSX (`.mlx`) and reaches the browser as the code Solid's own compiler emits for the same JSX. HeroUI's components are ported onto Kobalte, and rhp's charts are bound.

A reactive read in the wrong place does not compile, and neither does a prop left out, an attribute an element does not take, or a `match` in a `Switch` that misses a case. Solid's, Kobalte's and HeroUI's own documentation stays the reference for what a component does; these pages say how it is written in OCaml.

## Packages

- `solidtype`: Solid 1.9 bound whole, for Melange: signals, resources, stores, its components, its renderer, server rendering included.
- `ppx_solidtype`: rewrites the JSX of `.mlx` files into calls Melange compiles.
- `vite-plugin-solidtype`: turns those calls back into JSX for Solid's compiler. It is not on npm: it is the asset `vite-plugin-solidtype-<version>.tgz` of each release at https://github.com/hyphatech/solidtype/releases, at the version of the opam packages.
- `solidtype-kobalte`: Kobalte 0.13 bound whole, generated from its declarations.
- `solidtype-headless`: the components Kobalte lacks, with no style, and Kobalte's own where they need a fix.
- `solidtype-heroui`: HeroUI 3's components, ported onto Kobalte. Their look is `@import "@heroui/styles";` after Tailwind's, and for Segment, TrendChip and TextShimmer, which HeroUI has no styles for, `@import "vite-plugin-solidtype/heroui-extras.css";`.
- `solidtype-rhp`: rhp 2.2's charts.
- `solidtype-internationalized-date`: @internationalized/date, the values HeroUI's date components take.
- `solidtype-gravity-icons`: every icon of Gravity UI, the set HeroUI's examples draw: `ChevronDown` is `Solidtype_gravity_icons.Chevron_down`. It imports nothing from npm; `solidtype-heroui` depends on it and draws its own icons from it.

The opam packages come from open-opam: `opam repo add open-opam https://github.com/open-opam/opam-repository.git`. Each names the npm packages it imports in its opam field `x-npm-depends`: `bun add $(opam show solidtype-heroui --field x-npm-depends)`. In Vite, `solidtype()` goes before `solid()`.

## Writing it

- Every name is snake case, by one rule from the name in Solid's, Kobalte's or HeroUI's documentation: `onClick` is `on_click`, `aria-label` is `aria_label`, `isDisabled` is `is_disabled`; a keyword takes a trailing underscore, `class_`, `type_`. A module keeps its JavaScript name: `Solidtype_kobalte.Switch.Root`, `Solidtype_heroui.Button`.
- A value that may change is a thunk: `class_=(fun () -> ...)`, a child `(fun () -> Jsx.int (S.get count))`. A literal is given as it is.
- A function prop is the function itself, and one that takes nothing is `(fun _ -> ...)`, since `(fun () -> ...)` is a thunk.
- An optional prop is passed with `?`: `?title=(fun () -> note ())`, absent while `None`.
- A component is `let%component make ~(name : string) () = ...`, and reads a prop as a call, `name ()`; its tag is the module, `<Greeting name="Ada" />`. A root mounted by a page is a plain `let make () = ...`.
- A spread, TSX's `{...props}`, is the attribute `props`; no prop is named `props`.
- A `data-` attribute is a `Jsx.data`: `data_selected=(fun () -> Jsx.flag (on ()))`.
- A namespace wraps the value: `on:click={f}` is `on_click=(Jsx.native f)`.
- A part draws another element by `as_`, HeroUI's `render`.

```ocaml
module S = Solidtype.Solid
module Jsx = Solidtype.Jsx

let make () =
  let count, set_count = S.create_signal 0 in
  <button
    class_="button button--primary"
    type_=`button
    on_click=(fun _ -> S.update set_count succ)>
    "Clicked " (fun () -> Jsx.int (S.get count)) " times"
  </button>
```

## Start here

- [Getting Started](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/): SolidJS for modern OCaml: install, dune, Vite and a first page.
- [OCaml over TypeScript](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/start/ocaml-over-typescript/): Safe, readable and predictable, and still Solid underneath.
- [How it works](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/start/how-it-works/): One component, from OCaml's JSX to the code Solid's compiler emits.
- [Melange and dune](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/start/melange/): How components are built by dune, compiled by Melange, and why the libraries are shaped as they are.
- [Vite](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/start/vite/): The plugin in Vite, under Astro, and under vitest.
- [Astro](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/start/astro/): Build a site with Astro, its interactive parts written as OCaml islands.
- [Conventions](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/start/conventions/): How a name, a namespace, a data attribute, an optional prop and a spread from Solid's documentation are written in OCaml.

## Solid

- [Solid](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/solid/): Zero-cost bindings to Solid.
- [Components](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/solid/components/): A component in OCaml's JSX, its props, its children, and how the compiler checks them.
- [Reactivity](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/solid/reactivity/): Signals, derived values and effects, and why a reactive read is a thunk.
- [Control flow](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/solid/control-flow/): Show, For, Index, Switch and Match, ErrorBoundary and Portal, with OCaml's options and matches.
- [Stores and context](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/solid/state/): State tracked field by field, and a value given to every component below a provider.
- [Async](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/solid/async/): Resources, Suspense and transitions, with OCaml's options and results.
- [Rendering](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/solid/rendering/): Mounting in the browser, rendering on the server, and hydrating what the server rendered.

## Kobalte

- [Kobalte](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/kobalte/): Zero-cost bindings to Kobalte, generated from its own types.
- [The binding](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/kobalte/binding/): How solidtype-kobalte is generated from Kobalte's own declarations, and how Kobalte's types become OCaml's.
- [Using Kobalte](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/kobalte/usage/): Kobalte's components in OCaml's JSX, styled by their own data attributes.
- [Headless components](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/kobalte/headless/): Components Kobalte lacks, made as Kobalte makes its own, of its hooks, and Kobalte's own, fixed.

## HeroUI

Each component's page gives HeroUI's own examples in OCaml, and a table of its props with the name HeroUI's React component gives each.

- [HeroUI](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/): A maintained port of HeroUI's design system to solidtype.
- [Theming](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/theming/): Customize HeroUI's design system with CSS variables and global styles.
- [Styling](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/styling/): Style HeroUI components with CSS or Tailwind.
- [Composition](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/composition/): Build flexible UI with component composition patterns.
- [Coverage](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/coverage/): Which of HeroUI's components solidtype has ported.
- [Accordion](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/accordion/): A collapsible content panel for organizing information in a compact space.
- [Alert](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/alert/): Display important messages and notifications to users with status indicators.
- [AlertDialog](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/alert-dialog/): Modal dialog for critical confirmations requiring user attention and explicit action.
- [Autocomplete](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/autocomplete/): An autocomplete combines a select with filtering, allowing users to search and select from a list of options.
- [Avatar](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/avatar/): Display user profile images with customizable fallback content.
- [AvatarGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/avatar-group/): Display a stacked or grid group of avatars with overflow counting.
- [Badge](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/badge/): Displays a small indicator positioned relative to another element, commonly used for notification counts, status dots, and labels.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/breadcrumbs/): Navigation breadcrumbs showing the current page's location within a hierarchy.
- [Button](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/button/): A clickable button component with multiple variants and states.
- [ButtonGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/button-group/): Group related buttons together with consistent styling and spacing.
- [Card](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/card/): Flexible container component for grouping related content and actions.
- [Checkbox](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/checkbox/): Checkboxes allow users to select multiple items from a list of individual items, or to mark one individual item as selected.
- [CheckboxGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/checkbox-group/): A checkbox group component for managing multiple checkbox selections.
- [Chip](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/chip/): Small informational badges for displaying labels, statuses, and categories.
- [CloseButton](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/close-button/): Button component for closing dialogs, modals, or dismissing content.
- [ColorArea](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/color-area/): A 2D color picker that allows users to select colors from a gradient area.
- [ColorField](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/color-field/): Color input field with labels, descriptions, and validation.
- [ColorPicker](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/color-picker/): A composable color picker that synchronizes color value between multiple color components.
- [ColorSlider](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/color-slider/): A color slider allows users to adjust an individual channel of a color value.
- [ColorSwatch](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/color-swatch/): A visual preview of a color value with accessibility support.
- [ColorSwatchPicker](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/color-swatch-picker/): A list of color swatches that allows users to select a color from a predefined palette.
- [ComboBox](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/combo-box/): A combo box combines a text input with a listbox, allowing users to filter a list of options to items matching a query.
- [Description](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/description/): Provides supplementary text for form fields and other components.
- [Disclosure](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/disclosure/): A disclosure is a collapsible section with a header containing a heading and a trigger button, and a panel that wraps the content.
- [DisclosureGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/disclosure-group/): Container that manages multiple Disclosure items with coordinated expanded states.
- [Drawer](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/drawer/): Slide-out panel for supplementary content and actions.
- [Dropdown](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/dropdown/): A dropdown displays a list of actions or options that a user can choose.
- [EmptyState](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/empty-state/): What a list shows where it has nothing to show.
- [ErrorMessage](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/error-message/): An error message for non-form components such as a TagGroup.
- [FieldError](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/field-error/): Displays validation error messages for form fields.
- [Fieldset](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/fieldset/): Group related form controls with legends, descriptions, and actions.
- [Form](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/form/): Wrapper component for form validation and submission handling.
- [Input](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/input/): Primitive single-line text input component that accepts standard HTML attributes.
- [InputGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/input-group/): Group related input controls with prefix and suffix elements for enhanced form fields.
- [Kbd](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/kbd/): Display keyboard shortcuts and key combinations.
- [Label](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/label/): Renders an accessible label associated with form controls.
- [Link](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/link/): A styled anchor component for navigation with built-in icon support.
- [ListBox](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/list-box/): A listbox displays a list of options and allows a user to select one or more of them.
- [Meter](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/meter/): A meter represents a quantity within a known range, or a fractional value.
- [Modal](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/modal/): Dialog overlay for focused user interactions and important content.
- [NumberField](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/number-field/): Number input fields with increment/decrement buttons, validation, and internationalized formatting.
- [Pagination](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/pagination/): Page navigation with composable page links, previous/next buttons, and ellipsis indicators.
- [Popover](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/popover/): Displays rich content in a portal triggered by a button or any custom element.
- [ProgressBar](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/progress-bar/): A progress bar shows either determinate or indeterminate progress of an operation over time.
- [ProgressCircle](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/progress-circle/): A circular progress indicator that shows determinate or indeterminate progress.
- [RadioGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/radio-group/): Radio group for selecting a single option from a list.
- [ScrollShadow](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/scroll-shadow/): Apply visual shadows to indicate scrollable content overflow with automatic detection of scroll position.
- [SearchField](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/search-field/): Search input field with clear button and search icon.
- [Segment](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/segment/): A segmented control, for a few options of which one is selected.
- [Select](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/select/): A select displays a collapsible list of options and allows a user to select one of them.
- [Separator](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/separator/): Visually divide content sections.
- [Skeleton](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/skeleton/): Skeleton is a placeholder to show a loading state and the expected shape of a component.
- [Slider](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/slider/): A slider allows a user to select one or more values within a range.
- [Spinner](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/spinner/): A loading indicator component to show pending states.
- [Surface](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/surface/): Container component that provides surface-level styling and context for child components.
- [Switch](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/switch/): A toggle switch component for boolean states.
- [Table](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/table/): Tables display structured data in rows and columns with support for sorting, selection, column resizing, and infinite scrolling.
- [Tabs](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/tabs/): Tabs organize content into multiple sections and allow users to navigate between them.
- [TagGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/tag-group/): A focusable list of tags with support for keyboard navigation, selection, and removal.
- [TextArea](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/text-area/): Primitive multiline text input component that accepts standard HTML attributes.
- [TextField](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/text-field/): Composition-friendly text fields with labels, descriptions, and inline validation.
- [TextShimmer](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/text-shimmer/): Text with a highlight sweeping across it, for a label of work under way.
- [TimeField](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/time-field/): Time input field with labels, descriptions, and validation.
- [Toast](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/toast/): Display temporary notifications and messages to users with automatic dismissal and customizable placement.
- [ToggleButton](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/toggle-button/): An interactive toggle control for on/off or selected/unselected states.
- [ToggleButtonGroup](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/toggle-button-group/): Groups multiple ToggleButtons into a unified control, allowing users to select one or multiple options.
- [Tooltip](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/tooltip/): Displays informative text when users hover over or focus on an element.
- [TrendChip](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/trend-chip/): A chip that shows a change, its arrow and colour from its trend.
- [Typography](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/heroui/typography/): A semantic typography primitive for headings, body copy, and inline code.

## Charts

Each page links to the page of rhp's documentation it follows.

- [Charts](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/): Zero-cost bindings to rhp, Solid's reactive charts made of HTML.
- [Gallery](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/gallery/): rhp's gallery charts in OCaml: a waterfall, a pie, a heatmap, a Gantt chart and candlesticks.
- [Chart](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/chart/): The frame of a chart: its scale, its axis and its orientation.
- [Plot](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/plot/): A slat for each row, stacked in the chart's band, each in its place as the rows change.
- [Slat](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/slat/): The template for one row, with the CSS and layout every slat of its type shares.
- [Scale](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/scale/): An axis drawn as a plot of its ticks, from blocks.
- [Bar](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/bar/): A bar along the value axis, from one value to another.
- [Dot](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/dot/): A round point at a value, or at a value on each of two scales.
- [Tick](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/tick/): A short line across the band at a value: a goal, a median, a mark.
- [Label](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/label/): Text placed on the chart's scale, or outside it at an edge.
- [Cell](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/cell/): A cell of the band, coloured by its value on the scale.
- [Place](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/place/): A place on the scale, which draws nothing, for whatever is put in it.
- [Line](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/line/): A line through points: a sparkline in a slat, or a line chart on a second scale.
- [Area](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/area/): A filled outline across the band: ridgelines, or violins drawn both ways.
- [Many dots](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/many-dots/): Many points at once, without a slat or a computation for each.
- [Poster](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/poster/): A panel around a chart, as a magazine sets one: kicker, headline, dek and note.
- [Theme](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/theme/): The colours and font of every chart inside it.
- [Helpers](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/rhp/helpers/): The functions of data rhp gives: stacks, running totals, bins, summaries, densities.

## Reference

Each module's interface, its `.mli`, is its contract: what each function does, refuses and defaults to.

- [Reference](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/): The packages, and a link to each module's odoc page.
- [solidtype](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/solidtype/Solidtype/index.html): Solid's core, renderer, server rendering, stores and components, and the JSX the ppx writes.
- [solidtype-kobalte](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/solidtype-kobalte/Solidtype_kobalte/index.html): each of Kobalte's components, part by part, its hooks and values.
- [solidtype-headless](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/solidtype-headless/Solidtype_headless/index.html): the components Kobalte lacks, and Kobalte's own, fixed.
- [solidtype-heroui](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/solidtype-heroui/Solidtype_heroui/index.html): each port, one module each, and HeroUI's variant functions.
- [solidtype-rhp](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/solidtype-rhp/Solidtype_rhp/index.html): rhp's charts, and its functions of rows.
- [solidtype-internationalized-date](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/solidtype-internationalized-date/Solidtype_internationalized_date/index.html): dates, times and time zones.
- [solidtype-gravity-icons](https://hyphatech.github.io/solidtype/reference/solidtype-gravity-icons/Solidtype_gravity_icons/index.html): every icon of Gravity UI.
- [Source](https://github.com/hyphatech/solidtype): the repository, every `.mli` beside its module.
